entries.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics Data API
entries.licence_note: The ABS website copyright page says: "All material presented on this website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence, with the exception of:" and then lists the exceptions as the Commonwealth Coat of Arms, the ABS logo, material protected by a trade mark, unit record data (microdata), content supplied by third parties, sub-brands for ABS data products and projects (e.g. DataLab, SEAD), ‘Our story, our future’ artwork and brand, Census branding and artwork, and Occupation Standard Classification for Australia (OSCA) branding and artwork. Microdata is outside the licence and is not served by this API.
entries.description: ABS dataflows covering economic, social and Census statistics — the published dataflow list includes Consumer Price Index (CPI), Labour Force, Australian National Accounts Key Aggregates, Retail Trade and the Estimated Resident Population series — queried by dataflow, data key and period. "Data is available in XML, JSON and CSV. If no format is selected the API will return XML." Metadata is primarily XML, with some available in JSON. The guide says the service "is fully compliant with SDMX 2.1 - the Statistical Data and Metadata Exchange information model." Update cadence follows each ABS release; the guide notes that in the beta "data in this beta release may not necessarily be the most up to date."
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key: "As of the 29th of November 2024, Data API keys have been removed and we have transitioned to a register of interest system. The Data API is freely accessible without the need for an API key." The ABS labels the service a Beta and says "Availability of the ABS Data API (Beta) is not guaranteed. Performance and availability may be impacted during periods of high use."
entries.attribution: Required (CC BY 4.0). The copyright page says material from the site "is to be attributed to this department" and points to the ABS pages "Attributing ABS material" and "How to cite ABS sources".

entries.name: abuse.ch threat feeds
entries.licence_note: The provider gives Feodo Tracker and SSLBL CC0-style unrestricted commercial and non-commercial use. URLhaus and ThreatFox are free for authenticated not-for-profit use under unspecified reasonable-volume limits, and commercial or for-profit use may require a paid subscription. The terms also state: "Data or Confidential Information may not be used by users to customise, train, or otherwise improve any artificial intelligence model or product, collectively ‘AI Training’ without Spamhaus’ express prior written consent."
entries.auth: free Auth-Key for URLhaus and ThreatFox; none for checked Feodo Tracker and SSLBL files
entries.description: URLhaus dumps include active URLs, additions from the past 30 days or a full view including active URLs and additions from the past 90 days, and are generated every five minutes. ThreatFox recent-IOC queries cover one to seven days, with full exports available separately; Feodo Tracker and SSLBL generate principal blocklists every five minutes, and several IP lists use a 30-day activity window.
entries.free_tier_limits: URLhaus and ThreatFox require authentication and permit not-for-profit access within query and export volumes the provider considers reasonable; numeric community limits are not stated. Feodo Tracker and SSLBL are stated to be free without limitations under CC0 principles.
entries.rate_limits: URLhaus dumps: do not fetch more often than every 5 minutes. Feodo Tracker and SSLBL principal lists: generated every 5 minutes; numeric API query limits are not stated.

entries.name: AbuseIPDB API
entries.licence_note: The free plan is limited to evaluation, contribution and non-commercial personal projects; commercial use requires Basic or a higher paid plan. The terms prohibit reproducing, republishing, selling, reselling or exploiting the API and its data without a separate written agreement.
entries.description: The service accepts IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and supports report lookback windows from 1 to 365 days, defaulting to 30 days; verbose check responses include at most 10,000 reports. The free Individual plan provides 1,000 IP checks and reports, 100 block checks and a basic blacklist of up to 10,000 IPs per day, with five blacklist requests per day stated in the API table.
entries.free_tier_limits: Individual plan: 1,000 IP checks and reports per day, 100 block checks per day and a basic blacklist up to 10,000 IPs. The API rate table states five blacklist requests per day for the standard tier.
entries.rate_limits: Free standard tier per day: 1,000 check, 100 reports, 5 blacklist, 1,000 report submissions, 100 check-block, 5 bulk-report and 5 clear-address requests; HTTP 429 after the daily limit. The pricing page groups checks and reports as 1,000 per day.

entries.name: ACLED conflict event data
entries.licence_note: Non-commercial use only. ACLED's EULA says "Commercial entities may not access or use the Content and/or Platforms without first obtaining a corporate license from the Licensor." and bars use of its content as "training data, embeddings, or knowledge-base input for any model or system" without ACLED's express prior written consent. Link to ACLED rather than mirroring its data.
entries.description: ACLED completed worldwide geographic expansion in 2022, while country start dates vary and the earliest listed coverage begins in January 1997. Events are coded in real time and published weekly, with corrections and supplemental data added later. API responses default to at most 5,000 events, so larger results need pagination.
entries.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial use only. A free myACLED account provides API and export access for permitted non-commercial use. API calls return at most 5,000 events by default; use pagination for larger results.
entries.attribution: “ACLED as the source of the data must be clearly and prominently acknowledged.” Include the access date, filters and any manipulation or amendments.

entries.name: adsb.lol Open Flight Data
entries.licence_note: adsb.lol states that its API and public data are licensed under ODbL 1.0. The licence requires attribution and can require a redistributed adapted database to remain under ODbL; produced works must carry notice of the source database.
entries.description: Worldwide volunteer-receiver observations of aircraft transponder messages, including broadcast and multilaterated positions where available. Granularity: live aircraft snapshots and per-aircraft trace points; fields can include identity, altitude, speed, track, vertical rate, position, signal quality and observation age. The archive adds one release per day and retained 1,378 days on 2026-11-04. Live delay: the provider says no delay is added. Receiver coverage and field completeness vary geographically.
entries.free_tier_limits: The public API and daily historical releases are available without an account. Unkeyed API access is limited to 500 requests/day per IP; free keys provide 500/day for anonymous 30-day access, 1,000/day by request, or 7,200/day plus 20 GB/month for feeders.
entries.rate_limits: 500 requests/day per IP without a key; free key tiers provide 500/day, 1,000/day, or 7,200/day depending on eligibility
entries.attribution: Attribute adsb.lol and identify the ODbL 1.0 licence when publicly using or redistributing the database.

entries.name: ADSB IQ Daily Aircraft Data
entries.licence_note: The database is distributed under ODbL 1.0. The provider specifies the credit line ADSBiq feeder network.
entries.description: GitHub monthly releases hold 102 daily files spanning 2026-06-28 through 2026-10-10, with no files for 2026-07-08, 2026-07-19 or 2026-08-30, from the ADSB IQ feeder network. The repository README states: "This archive is no longer updated. The last daily file is for 2026-10-10." It adds that existing files were reissued on 2026-11-02 with privacy-restricted aircraft removed. Files use adaptive trace thinning with a 30-second cruise heartbeat; October files hold roughly 30-34 million rows and about 0.47-0.59 GB each.
entries.free_tier_limits: Archived daily Parquet files are public with no account, token or stated download limit. October files are roughly 0.47-0.59 GB each; the archive is no longer updated.
entries.rate_limits: No rate limit stated for daily files
entries.attribution: ADSBiq feeder network

entries.name: AviationWeather.gov Data API
entries.licence_note: Recorded as Custom because the terms are the National Weather Service's public-domain statement rather than a licence id. The NWS disclaimer says: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose so long as you do not: 1) claim it is your own (e.g., by claiming copyright for NWS information -- see below), 2) use it in a manner that implies an endorsement or affiliation with NOAA/NWS, or 3) modify its content and then present it as official government material." The same page adds that use of the NWS name and visual identifier is protected under trademark law and needs NWS permission, except to identify unaltered NWS content or links to NWS sites.
entries.description: By product, as the docs list coverage: METAR terminal observations and TAF terminal forecasts (worldwide), SIGMET aviation warnings (worldwide), PIREPs/AIREPs ("Primarily US and North Atlantic"), G-AIRMETs ("Contiguous 48 United States"), AIRMETs (Alaska), area forecasts (Alaska), area forecast discussions, center weather advisories and meteorological impact statements (United States), the TFM Convective Forecast ("United States, portions of Canada"), and station, airport and navigation-feature information (worldwide). Formats vary by product across raw text, JSON, GeoJSON, CSV, XML and IWXXM. History: "The weather database currently allows access to up to the previous 30 days of data." Gzipped cache files of the current full datasets are updated once a minute (the stations listing once a day).
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key. History is capped: "The weather database currently allows access to up to the previous 30 days of data." Gzipped cache files of the current full datasets are published for bulk use and the docs recommend them over large custom queries.
entries.rate_limits: "All requests are rate limited to 100 requests per minute. Most endpoints return a maximum of 400 entries (please consider using cache files for larger requests)." The docs also say "Cross-origin resource sharing is not permitted at this time." and ask clients to "Set a custom user agent to prevent automated filtering inadvertently blocking valid traffic."
entries.attribution: Not required; do not imply NOAA/NWS endorsement or affiliation, do not claim the information as your own, and do not present modified content as official government material.

entries.licence_note: The terms say: "The emissions data and associated metadata has been made available via Climate TRACE under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0), with the exception of external datasets listed below." The listed sources include EDGAR and FAOSTAT country-level estimates for several sectors and source-level estimates from the European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register, the US EPA FLIGHT dataset, the US EPA Landfill Methane Outreach Program, Canada's Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program and the Israel Pollutant Release and Transfer Register. The terms add: "It is the sole responsibility of the user to review the terms and conditions for all the above sources prior to using the data."
entries.description: Emissions estimates by gas, sector and subsector for countries, administrative areas, cities and individual emitting sources, plus asset-owner records and country rankings. The data page says of the latest release: "October release 5.12.0 includes monthly emissions data through August 2026." Higher-resolution geospatial files are available on request and the full dataset is also mirrored in Google BigQuery (billed by Google).
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key, for both the downloads and the v7 API. The data page says: "As a beta release, we cannot guarantee availability of the Climate TRACE API; please keep volume low and use it with caution in production settings." Higher-resolution geospatial files are available on request; the BigQuery copy is billed by Google.
entries.rate_limits: Not stated as a number; the provider asks beta API users to keep volume low.
entries.attribution: Required (CC BY 4.0): attribute Climate TRACE and indicate any changes; the terms link a suggested citation format.

entries.name: Delphi Epidata API (Carnegie Mellon University)
entries.licence_note: WARNING: licence varies by signal, not one blanket licence. CC BY sources: "These data sources are provided under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution license: COVID-19 Trends and Impact Survey Doctor Visits Hospital Admissions Indicator Combination (signals with names beginning nmf_*) Quidel You may use this data for any purpose, provided you attribute us as the original source, as shown above." CC BY-NC sources: "These data sources are provided under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial license: Change Healthcare Youtube Survey You may not use this data for commercial purposes, but all other uses are permitted, provided you attribute us as the original source." Republished/mirrored sources: "These data streams are essentially mirrors of their respective sources, and are published here subject to the original license provided by the source" — their list includes COVID Act Now, Google Health Trends, Google Search Trends, HHS/NSHN Hospitalizations, Indicator Combination (cases and deaths signals), JHU CSSE Cases and Deaths, NCHS Mortality, NSSP ED Visits, SafeGraph Mobility and USAFacts Cases and Deaths, each under its own source's licence.
entries.description: Signal metadata and time series across sources such as NSSP ED Visits, NHSN Hospitalizations, NWSS Wastewater, Doctor Visits, FluView ILINet, NCHS Mortality Data and more, by geography (county, state, national) and day. Anonymous access is "public datasets only", with "only two parameters may have multiple selections"; a free registered key removes both limits. Update cadence: Not stated as one figure; varies by source.
entries.free_tier_limits: Anonymous access, no key: "public datasets only", "rate-limited to 60 requests per hour", "only two parameters may have multiple selections". A free registered API key removes the rate limit and the multiple-selection limit.
entries.rate_limits: Anonymous: "rate-limited to 60 requests per hour". Registered key: "no rate limit".
entries.attribution: Required for Delphi's own novel data: "Data from Delphi COVIDcast. Obtained via the Delphi Epidata API. https://cmu-delphi.github.io/delphi-epidata/api/covidcast.html". CC BY and CC BY-NC sources above also require attributing Delphi as the original source; mirrored/republished sources require following that source's own attribution terms.

entries.name: DigitalNZ API
entries.licence_note: Custom. The developers page says the API is "free and open for anyone to use to search across the metadata". The Developer API terms say the API may be used with or without an API key, that partner metadata with a known open licence is listed in the rights field (the same page names Europeana and DPLA CC0, data.govt.nz and NZ Gazette CC BY 3.0 NZ, Lincoln University CC0, and Alexander Turnbull Library CC BY 4.0), and that the default non-commercial terms allow copying, using and distributing metadata in your own websites and applications for non-commercial purposes. A separate "Commercial use metadata" section exists on the same page. The terms cover metadata (including small thumbnails), not digital objects or large thumbnails. Agent note: treat unspecified metadata as non-commercial unless the rights field or a listed partner licence says otherwise, or you follow the commercial-use metadata terms; check the rights field before commercial reuse; do not treat the whole API as CC BY or CC0. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Search New Zealand cultural and government collection metadata via the DigitalNZ API. This entry is the keyless v3 metadata search API, not partner digital objects or large thumbnails.

entries.rate_limits: 10,000 API calls per day per issued API key, and a shared 10,000 calls per day in total for keyless users (Developer API terms, clauses 12(a)–(b)). Higher limits are by contact with DigitalNZ. A key is optional, not required; this entry is the keyless path.
entries.attribution: Follow the provider's terms (see the licence note) and credit the provider as the source.

entries.description: England. entries.name: Environment Agency Hydrology Data API
entries.licence_note: The licence is published inside the API: the reference says "The metadata description included in JSON and RDF results provides information about the API, such as the publisher and applicable licence.", and the stations response read on 2026-11-09 gave "licenseName": "OGL 3" with a nationalarchives.gov.uk Open Government Licence v3.0 link (the link in the response body is in plain http; Signal Lab links to the https address). The service's own footer says "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated".
entries.description: Monitoring stations, measures and readings for river flow, river level, groundwater level, rainfall and water-quality parameters (dissolved oxygen, fluorescent dissolved organic matter, blue-green algae, turbidity, chlorophyll, conductivity, temperature, ammonium, nitrate and pH), at 15-minute and daily resolution depending on the parameter. The reference says the service "provides data from nearly eight thousand monitoring stations, and includes sub-daily (typically 15 min) resolution time series as well as wider range of daily time series" and "provides access to over four billion rows of readings." Responses are available as JSON, CSV, HTML, RDF, Turtle and GeoJSON, and a batch API queues larger requests.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key or registration. Row limits apply per call: "The API calls that return readings data have a soft limit of 100,000 rows per-call which can be overridden by setting a _limit parameter." and "However, we current set a hard limit of 2,000,000 rows, which cannot be overridden." A batch API queues larger requests.
entries.rate_limits: No numeric request rate is stated. For bulk downloads the Agency asks: "Ideally limit to one request in flight at a time, waiting for each request to finish before issuing the next." and reserves "the right to enforce limits on the number of concurrent requests (per IP address or identifiable group of IP addresses)".

If you distribute it, attribute Euronext as the source where reasonably practicable and include Euronext's prominent disclaimer; distributing it for a fee or otherwise commercially benefiting requires an agreement with Euronext (the Euronext Market Data Agreement, EMDA, applies).
entries.description: Delayed post-trade files (zipped CSV, UTC timestamps) for Euronext Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Milan, Oslo and Paris. File types: equities; ETFs and funds; warrants and certificates; fixed income; equity and index derivatives; commodity derivatives. Time windows: last 15 minutes, last hour, current trading day, since previous trading day, previous trading day. Files are generated on request, published with at most a 15-minute delay and available for at least 24 hours; no long history. Regulatory delayed transparency data, not a real-time feed.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free CSV (zipped) downloads with no registration or key; files available for at least 24 hours after publication. No download or request limit stated.
entries.attribution: When distributing: attribute Euronext as the source where reasonably practicable and include the disclaimer "© <year> Euronext N.V. All Rights Reserved. ..." set out in clause 5 of the delayed-data terms.

entries.licence_note: The download page says: "Price Paid Data is released under the Open Government Licence (OGL)." and that under the OGL, HM Land Registry permits use "for commercial or non-commercial purposes." Price Paid Data contains address data processed against Ordnance Survey’s AddressBase Premium product, which incorporates Royal Mail’s PAF® database (Address Data)." entries.licence_note: Licence is shown per dataset on the platform rather than as one blanket licence; many datasets use CC BY 4.0. Example dataset listing: "Data format: NetCDF Dataset period: 2012-01-01 to present License: CC-BY-4.0 APIs: Open Data API Notification Service EDR API".
entries.auth: API key (registered or shared anonymous key)
entries.description: Licence and coverage are set per dataset on the platform. For example, the in-situ surface observations listing shows: "Data format: NetCDF Dataset period: 2012-01-01 to present License: CC-BY-4.0 APIs: Open Data API Notification Service EDR API". Published Open Data API rate limits and quotas: registered key 200 requests/second and 1000 requests/hour; anonymous key 50 requests/minute (shared) and 3000 requests/hour (shared); dataset bulk key 100 requests/second, quota is the amount of files per dataset.
entries.free_tier_limits: KNMI developer docs: "All endpoints are protected and can be accessed using a valid API key, passed in the Authorization header of the HTTP request." KNMI offers three key varieties: "anonymous, registered and bulk. For normal usage, we recommend to use the registered key." The anonymous key "provides unregistered access to open data and is shared among all unregistered users." APIs offered: Open Data API, Notification Service, EDR API.
entries.rate_limits: KNMI Open Data API key rate limits and quotas, as published: Registered open data API key — 200 requests/second, 1000 requests/hour. Anonymous open data API key — 50 requests/minute (shared), 3000 requests/hour (shared). Dataset bulk open data API key — 100 requests/second, quota is the amount of files per dataset.

Accepted measurements are exposed rapidly through OONI Explorer and batched to S3 once an hour; API searches cannot span more than 180 days per request and are not intended for bulk extraction.
entries.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial use only. Keyless read API and unsigned public S3 access. Measurement API time ranges are capped at 180 days; use S3 rather than the API for bulk data.

entries.name: Open Charge Map API
entries.licence_note: Recorded as Custom because the licence is split by data source. The terms page says: "Data contributed to us by our users which we then redistribute is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)." and "Data imported from 3rd party Data Providers is copyright the original Data Provider in each case and is not provided under the same terms as the user-contributed data detailed above." WARNING: the developing-using page (https://openchargemap.org/develop, not /develop/api) requires visible attribution: "Use of our API or data in an application or service requires that the appropriate Data Provider attribution (including license terms) be provided in a way which is visible the end user."

The embeddable web app (map.openchargemap.io) can be set up in an iframe as an alternative to the API. Update cadence: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free API key required; an unauthenticated sample call returned: "You must specify an API key using the key query parameter or x-api-key header."

entries.name: Open Data BCN (Barcelona)
entries.licence_note: Recorded as CC-BY-4.0 because the terms page says: "Most data sets are published under the terms and conditions of Creative Commons- Attribution(CC-BY 4.0) licence, under which such data are allowed :"; it also says: "any data involving third-party participation may be reused under a Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivs (CC BY-ND 4.0) licence". Check each dataset's own licence field, since not every dataset is CC BY 4.0.
entries.description: The CKAN package_list endpoint returned 558 dataset slugs today (for example accidents-gu-bcn, accessibilitat-via-publica and cens-activitats-economiques-class-bcn); package_show and datastore_search retrieve a given dataset's metadata and row-level data. Each dataset carries its own licence (CC-BY 4.0, or CC BY-ND 4.0 for datasets involving third-party participation). History start and update frequency: Not stated beyond per-dataset metadata.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key. CKAN package_list/package_show/datastore_search.
entries.rate_limits: Not stated on the pages read today.

entries.name: Open Data Nepal catalog API
entries.licence_note: Custom. Three signals, all quoted: (1) the Data Policy says that, unless otherwise stated, datasets are under an open licence such as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, that users may use, modify and share them with appropriate attribution, and that commercial use is permitted unless explicitly restricted; (2) the home footer text says "All content is licensed under aCreative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License" (missing space after "a" is in the page), and that visible text is a link whose href is the CC BY-SA 4.0 deed (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, present in the raw HTML, not in the rendered text); (3) package metadata is unversioned cc-by / "Creative Commons Attribution" (the opendefinition.org cc-by page). The licence is ambiguous. Agent note: treat it as CC BY-SA 4.0 (the stricter reading) to be safe — give attribution and apply share-alike if you adapt. Check each dataset's licence field when a dataset states a restriction. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Nepal open datasets catalog from Open Knowledge Nepal via a keyless CKAN API. The catalog is updated as contributing publishers add or refresh datasets.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.
entries.attribution: Follow the provider's terms (see the licence note) and credit the provider as the source.

entries.name: Open Energy Platform (OEP) REST API
entries.licence_note: Custom: the Terms of Use apply Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Germany to every data set and work unless noted otherwise, and each table's metadata can name its own licence, so check each table's licence before reuse. The licence does not cover personal data, project or institution logos, or unlawfully published material. Read endpoints are keyless; write endpoints need an account token. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Energy-system modelling data tables and factsheets via the keyless OEP REST API.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.
entries.attribution: Follow the provider's terms (see the licence note) and credit the provider as the source.

entries.name: Open English Wordnet
entries.licence_note: CC-BY-4.0. The resource is derived from Princeton WordNet (WordNet License) and further developed under CC BY 4.0 International; attribution is required to both Princeton WordNet and the Open English Wordnet team. Bulk LMF/JSON/RDF/WNDB releases are also published at en-word.net. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: CC BY 4.0 lexical database of English with a keyless JSON API and releases.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.
entries.attribution: Required under CC BY 4.0: credit the provider as the source and link the licence.

entries.name: Open Food Facts database and API
entries.licence_note: The terms of use say: "The Open Food Facts database is available under the Open Database License." and "Products images are available under the Creative Commons Attribution ShareAlike licence." Recorded as ODbL-1.0 for the database; product images carry a separate CC BY-SA licence.
entries.description: Crowd-sourced global packaged-food products by barcode (ingredients, nutrition, Nutri-Score, labels, origins); continuous community edits; nightly CSV/Parquet/MongoDB exports for bulk use. Total product count and history start: Not stated on the checked pages.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, keyless JSON API within the stated per-minute limits; nightly CSV/Parquet/MongoDB exports for bulk use.
entries.rate_limits: "15 req/min/IP address for all read product queries"; "10 req/min/IP address for all search queries"; bulk work should use the nightly exports instead.
entries.attribution: Required (ODbL attribution and share-alike for the database; CC BY-SA for images).

entries.name: Government of Canada CKAN API
entries.licence_note: The Open Government Licence – Canada permits worldwide, royalty-free commercial and non-commercial reuse, modification and distribution. It requires source acknowledgement and excludes personal information, unlicensed third-party rights, official symbols and separately protected material.
entries.description: The catalogue covers data and information published by Canadian federal departments and agencies. Update schedules, temporal coverage and resource formats vary by dataset; the catalogue API supports GET requests only, and no query cap is stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: The public catalogue Action API needs no key and supports GET requests only. Query and download caps are not stated; terms and formats can differ for linked resources.
entries.attribution: "Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada."

entries.name: Open Library APIs (Internet Archive)
entries.licence_note: Custom: the Internet Archive asserts no new rights over the Open Library database; material contributed from other sources may still carry its own rights.
entries.description: Global book metadata (works, editions, authors, ISBNs, subjects, covers). The API page says: "Open Library provides APIs in JSON, YAML and RDF/XML formats to support public-good, open, human-centered book discovery and lookup services." A test search for "signal processing" returned 7,572 matching works.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless APIs and monthly data dumps; the usage guidelines ask for a User-Agent and discourage use as a high-traffic backend.
entries.rate_limits: "Default (non-identified requests): 1 request per second Identified requests (with User-Agent and email): 3 requests per second"
entries.tasks: research-grey-literature; books; isbn; bibliographic-metadata; bulk-download; api
entries.attribution: No attribution requirement stated on the licensing page.

entries.name: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast API
entries.licence_note: The terms state: "You accept to the CC-BY 4.0 licence". The licence page names Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). The no-key API service is non-commercial only; the data licence itself permits reuse with attribution.
entries.description: Global coordinate-based forecasts. The general forecast endpoint returns 7 days by default and up to 16 days, with model coverage, resolution and update timing varying by location and model. This entry uses hourly 2 m temperature and precipitation in UTC.
entries.free_tier_limits: No key; non-commercial use only. Less than 10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour and 600/minute. Pricing also lists 300,000 calls/month.
entries.rate_limits: Less than 10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour and 600/minute; applied by IP address and application
entries.attribution: Required: "This licence mandates giving appropriate credit and indicating any modifications made to the data." Include an Open-Meteo link next to displayed locations.

entries.name: Open Ownership BODS bulk data (GLEIF and UK PSC/Register of Overseas Entities, mapped to the Beneficial Ownership Data Standard)
entries.licence_note: "This dataset is published under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication licence." Applies to both datasets on the page: GLEIF Level 1/2 data mapped to BODS, and the UK People with Significant Control (PSC) Register and Register of Overseas Entities mapped to BODS. Open Ownership also cautions: "These mappings are currently a work in progress and should be treated with caution."
entries.description: Two datasets: GLEIF Level 1/2 data mapped to BODS, and the UK People with Significant Control (PSC) Register and Register of Overseas Entities mapped to BODS — public-register records naming beneficial owners of UK companies and overseas entities owning UK property. Files are CSV, SQLite, Postgres dump, JSON, Parquet and BigQuery/Datasette. Update cadence: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key, as static bulk files (CSV, SQLite, Postgres dump, JSON, Parquet, BigQuery/Datasette).
entries.tasks: money-flows; beneficial-ownership; corporate-registry; bulk-data; cc0; files
entries.attribution: Not required under CC0; no specific credit wording is stated on the checked page.

entries.name: Open Targets Platform API
entries.licence_note: The licence page says: "Open Targets Platform is marked with CC0 1.0. This dedicates the data to the public domain, allowing downstream users to consume the data without restriction." It adds: "Please note that all data sources listed in the table, including the ones labeled with 'commercial use for Open Targets', have agreed for their data to be used without restriction by all Open Targets users."
entries.description: Target-disease association evidence (genetics, known drugs, pathways, RNA/protein expression, literature) built from partner data sources, confirmed live today via a GraphQL meta query (data version 26.09). History start and update frequency: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key. Confirmed live today via a GraphQL meta query; the API names itself "Open Targets GraphQL & REST API Beta" (data version 26.09).
entries.tasks: research-grey-literature; biology; drug-target; genetics; api; open-data
entries.attribution: Not required (CC0).

entries.name: Open Tree of Life web APIs
entries.licence_note: The licences page publishes data with a CC0 public domain dedication linked to the CC0 1.0 deed, except where pre-existing terms of use apply. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: A synthetic tree of life and reference taxonomy, via keyless POST methods.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API (POST methods with a JSON body).
entries.attribution: Not required under CC0; citing Open Tree of Life and the source studies is good practice.

entries.name: OpenAIRE Graph API
entries.licence_note: OpenAIRE says "the records returned by the service can be freely re-used by commercial and non-commercial partners under CC-BY license, hence as long as OpenAIRE is acknowledged as a data source." Its licence page adds that parts of the graph can be re-used as CC-0.
entries.auth: none (60 requests/hour); free account token for up to 7,200/hour
entries.description: Metadata aggregated from "a wide range of scholarly resources"; the full OpenAIRE Graph can also be downloaded in bulk. Offset paging stops at 10,000 results per query, so use cursor paging or the bulk dump for more. Publication delay: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Unauthenticated: up to 60 requests per hour. Registered users: up to 7,200 requests per hour with a personal access token, used for up to one hour at a time. Offset paging stops at 10,000 results per query.
entries.attribution: Acknowledge OpenAIRE as the data source.

entries.name: OpenAlex API
entries.licence_note: OpenAlex says "Every record is released under a CC0 public-domain license, with no “personal use only” carve-out and no permission to ask." Titles, abstracts and affiliation strings come from external sources and are passed through as-is.
entries.auth: none for basic use; free API key raises the daily budget 10x
entries.description: OpenAlex says its default curated core corpus has "300M+ works"; an opt-in expansion (corpus=all, mostly datasets and repository records) adds roughly 60% more works. The whole database can also be downloaded as a snapshot "refreshed every quarter"; the daily snapshot and the API's since-a-date sync filters are paid Member+ and Partner services. Publication delay: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: No key: basic queries at up to 10 requests per second. Free key: $1 of API usage per day (resets at midnight UTC), 30 requests per second and cursor paging past the first page; a new account spends its first $1 at up to $0.10 every 5 minutes. per_page is at most 100 and basic paging stops at 10,000 results.
entries.rate_limits: 10 requests/second without a key, 30 with a free key or prepaid usage, 50 on annual plans; semantic search 1 request/second

entries.name: OpenAQ API v3
entries.licence_note: OpenAQ's terms say "Attribution to OpenAQ as the source data is also required when using OpenAQ services for accessing the data." and that OpenAQ users "must therefore review and comply with any terms published by data providers" (per-source Creative Commons, open-government or bespoke licences). The terms add: "we provide no assurance that the data provided may be used free of any third-party claims." They also say: "However, utilizing our official, hosted API implementation to develop products or services that substantially duplicate or directly compete with OpenAQ’s core offerings is prohibited." "This restriction applies specifically to the use of our hosted API service, not to self-hosted instances or modified versions of the open-source code." v1 and v2 were retired 2025-01-31 (now HTTP 410); only v3 is live and it requires the free key.
entries.description: Not stated as a country, station or sensor count on the checked pages; v3 is the only live API version after the 2025-01-31 retirement of v1/v2. Querying api.openaq.org/v3/locations without a key returned HTTP 401 on 2026-11-05 (expected; v3 requires a key), while the documentation pages returned HTTP 200.
entries.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute, 2,000/hour (free key)
entries.rate_limits: 60 requests/minute, 2,000 requests/hour on the free "General use" key; a custom paid tier covers higher-volume use. One API key per individual.
entries.attribution: Attribution to OpenAQ as the source is required when using OpenAQ services for accessing the data; per-source data-provider attribution/licence terms may also apply. Do not use the official hosted API to build products or services that substantially duplicate or directly compete with OpenAQ's core offerings (restriction applies to the hosted API, not self-hosted or modified open-source instances).

entries.name: OpenCitations Index and Meta API
entries.licence_note: OpenCitations says "The data held in any of the OpenCitations datasets are available under a Creative Commons public domain dedication (CC0)." and that its data "may be freely reused for any purpose, including commercial purposes".
entries.description: Citation data held in the OpenCitations Index, where each field value is prefixed with the source index it comes from, plus bibliographic metadata in OpenCitations Meta. Database dumps are available for large-scale retrieval. Publication delay: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: No token required; a free access token is encouraged for code. 180 requests per minute per IP address; use the database dumps for large-scale retrieval.

Commercial use is allowed. External providers and a minority of records use another licence (data.json: 246/286 cc-zero; also CC BY 4.0, DL-DE-Zero-2.0, and 3 CC BY-NC 4.0). Agent note: check the dataset description; do not treat an NC record as CC0. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: City of Bonn open data catalog via a keyless DKAN API.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.
entries.attribution: Not required under CC0 1.0; crediting the provider as the source is good practice.

Commercial and non-commercial use is allowed with attribution as set out on the Nutzungsbedingungen page and the GovData deed. A few catalogue records use another open licence; check the dataset record when it is marked otherwise. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: City of Munich open data catalog via a keyless CKAN API.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.

Check a dataset's record if it is marked otherwise, including data from outside providers. The terms also bar using official marks or implying endorsement. Signal Lab links only.

Archive paths checked begin by November 2017, and the registry states an update frequency of approximately every five minutes. Coverage depends on participating devices, their uptime and their locations.

"Maximum record count 500" per request (the limit parameter). Update cadence: Not stated.

WARNING: device records that reproduce GMDN terminology are separately licensed — the same page says any extraction of that content for commercial re-use "must first obtain an appropriate license from The GMDN Agency."

For food enforcement, the overview page says: "Currently, this data covers publicly releasable records from 2004-present. The data is updated weekly." Other endpoints' history and update cadence vary and are not stated as one figure here.

entries.name: OpenFEC API
entries.licence_note: Non-commercial use only. Under "Don’t", the openFEC acceptable use policy lists: "use campaign finance information disclosed on fec.gov or through openFEC, the FEC's API, for commercial purposes including, but not limited to training data for large language models, machine learning models or artificial intelligence models, including generative artificial intelligence models". The FEC's sale-or-use page separately restricts the use of individual contributor information.
entries.description: The service covers current and historic U.S. federal campaign-finance data and is updated nightly. A free key allows 1,000 calls per hour, each limited to 100 results per page; the FEC accepts requests for a 7,200-calls-per-hour limit.
entries.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial use only. A free API key enables up to 1,000 calls per hour, with up to 100 results per page; users may request a 7,200-calls-per-hour limit from the FEC.
entries.rate_limits: 1,000 calls per hour with a free key; 7,200 calls per hour (120 per minute) may be requested
entries.attribution: The terms say: "All services which utilize or access the API should identify openFEC API as the data source."

entries.name: OpenFEMA API
entries.licence_note: OpenFEMA Terms and Conditions: data use is restricted to "statistical research or as a reporting record", re-identification is barred, and the data "cannot be used to make determinations that might affect an individual’s rights or eligibility for benefits."
entries.description: Datasets ("Entities") are returned in json, jsona, jsonl, geojson, csv or parquet. By default only 1,000 records are returned per request: "Currently the default value is 1,000 records. The maximum value is 10,000 records." History start and update frequency: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key; default page size 1,000 records, maximum 10,000 records per request ("$top").

The Federal Government or FEMA cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from the Agency's website(s)."

entries.name: OpenFIGI
entries.licence_note: FIGI Open Symbology is standardized under OMG / X9. OpenFIGI FAQ states there is no cost recovery, licensing fee or re-use restriction for FIGI symbology; the API does not return third-party proprietary identifiers such as CUSIP.
entries.description: Symbology / identifier mapping only — not prices, fundamentals or news. Global listed instruments addressable via OpenFIGI id types (ticker, ISIN and others documented on the API). Unlisted equities are excluded unless includeUnlistedEquities is true. API v3 is current (v2 deprecated around 2026-06-30). No public bulk flat files; UI CSV export is capped.
entries.free_tier_limits: No key: Mapping 25 requests/minute and 10 jobs/request. Free OpenFIGI API key: Mapping 250 requests/minute and 100 jobs/request. Search/Filter lower (5 requests/minute without key, 20 with key). No daily/weekly/monthly Mapping cap stated on the overview.
entries.rate_limits: Mapping 25 req/min without key (10 jobs/request); 250 req/min with free API key (100 jobs/request). Search/Filter 5 req/min without key, 20 with key.

entries.name: OpenHolidays API

The data repository LICENSE is the ODbL text; GitHub classifies that repo as ODbL-1.0, but the file heading does not print a version number, so this entry does not stamp SPDX ODbL-1.0 (12k: version only when the instrument itself names it). ODbL share-alike applies to derivative databases; contents remain factual public-holiday and school-holiday records compiled from official sources listed on the docs site. The API service repo is separately AGPL-3.0 (software, not used as the data licence). Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Public and school holidays via a keyless open data REST API under ODbL.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless API.

entries.name: OpenPhish Community Feed

entries.description: OpenPhish describes global coverage and limits its products to newly discovered, currently active phishing URLs. The Community Feed updates every 12 hours and has no archive; the checked file contained 300 URLs.
entries.free_tier_limits: Community Feed only: plain text, limited data, updated every 12 hours, no archive. Use is restricted to personal, academic or independent research that does not support business operations.

entries.name: OpenRailwayMap (OSM rail infrastructure tiles and API)

The API page says "Small scale applications with few or relatively small requests are allowed to use the API and tiles free and without charge." and "If you use the tiles or the API in a for-profit context, set up your own servers." Credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors" and OpenRailwayMap as the page requires.

entries.rate_limits: Not stated as a number; bulk requests are forbidden and HTTP 429 means stop
entries.attribution: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors; style CC-BY-SA 2.0 OpenRailwayMap (or "Service by OpenRailwayMap" for API data).

entries.name: OpenSanctions bulk data and API

entries.auth: none for bulk files; API key for hosted API

Bulk files are replaced daily at stable locations, so counts and file sizes change; the simplified Default CSV was about 450 MB when checked. Coverage and record precision vary across the underlying sources.

entries.name: OpenSeaMap

entries.description: Global volunteer-mapped nautical features where contributors have added seamarks and harbour data; coverage quality varies by region and is Not stated as a completeness percentage on the checked pages. Update frequency follows OpenStreetMap edits (continuous); a single official refresh SLA is Not stated.

entries.name: OpenSSF Scorecard REST API

The README says weekly-scan results omit the CI-Tests, Contributors and Dependency-Update-Tool checks because of the API costs of running them at scale. Running the Scorecard CLI or GitHub Action on other repositories is a separate, local tool and not this source.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless REST API.

entries.name: Reserve Bank of Australia payments statistics
entries.licence_note: Custom, not CC-BY-4.0 SPDX. The same Copyright and Disclaimer Notice that licenses most website material under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International also says the Cash Rate, the Chart Pack, other financial data and econometric models are subject to special conditions in sections 4, 5 and 6. Section 5 (Financial Data) allows personal or commercial use of Financial Data and Financial Data Materials provided the RBA is not stated or implied to endorse the use or any derived product, and it forbids "improper commercial exploitation" (including charging a fee for access without telling customers that the Bank publishes the same data without a fee). Agent note: official payments statistics are treated here as Financial Data under section 5, which is the stricter reading, not as "most other material" under CC BY 4.0. Attribute the RBA; do not imply endorsement; do not use the RBA logo except as that notice allows. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Reserve Bank of Australia retail payments statistics and tables as CSVs. Retail payments statistical releases are monthly; table CSVs are updated on the statistical-tables page. Do not quote a month's edition title as a licence line.

entries.description: Onionoo serves summary, details, bandwidth, weights, clients and uptime documents for relays and bridges; "By default, all relays and bridges are included that have been running in the past week." CollecTor carries relay server descriptors, extra-info descriptors, network status consensuses and votes, microdescriptors, bridge descriptors and other document types: "recent descriptors that were published in the last 72 hours are available as plain text, and archived descriptors covering many years of Tor network history are available as compressed tarballs". Records describe relays and bridges, including the IP addresses, nicknames and contact strings their operators publish to the public Tor directory.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key. Onionoo asks clients to request gzip and to use conditional requests; CollecTor publishes recent descriptors as plain text for the last 72 hours and older ones as compressed tarballs.
entries.rate_limits: Not stated. Onionoo's client rules ask for an "Accept-Encoding: gzip" header and for "Last-Modified"/"If-Modified-Since" conditional requests instead of giving a numeric limit.
entries.attribution: Not required for the data (CC0). Attribution is required for the site's graphs, which are under CC BY 3.0 US.

entries.name: UCDP Conflict Data API
entries.licence_note: UCDP states that all current datasets are CC BY 4.0 and may be used and redistributed with citation of the relevant publications listed for each dataset.
entries.description: The global georeferenced event series covers organized violence from 1989, while the UCDP/PRIO armed-conflict and dyadic yearly series begin in 1946. Final datasets are versioned annually; Candidate event data is released monthly with no more than one month's lag globally. The API allows 5,000 requests per day, errors included, and requires paging.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free token requested by email with intended use; requests are reviewed in 3–5 working days. API quota is 5,000 requests per day and errors count.
entries.attribution: For UCDP GED 26.1, cite: "Shawn Davies, Therése Pettersson, Magnus Öberg, Organized violence 1989–2025, and violent political protests, Journal of Peace Research, 2026" and "Sundberg, Ralph and Erik Melander (2013) Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset. Journal of Peace Research 50(4)."

entries.description: United States wind turbines. The database is continuously updated, and releases generally lag installations by about one quarter. The page says the database "provides the locations of land-based and offshore wind turbines in the United States, corresponding wind project information, and turbine technical specifications." A web viewer, metadata and a codebook are linked.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free CSV, shapefile and GeoJSON downloads and REST map services; no key.
entries.attribution: Requested: the acknowledgment statement on the USWTDB page, naming the U.S. Wind Turbine Database, USGS, the American Clean Power Association and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, with a link to energy.usgs.gov/uswtdb.

entries.name: USGS Volcano Hazards Program CAP alerts feed (HANS)
entries.licence_note: The CAP feed's own copyright field says "public domain". The USGS copyrights page says: "USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain." Recorded as Custom rather than an SPDX id because the provider declares US public domain status in its own words; the same page warns that some non-USGS photographs, images and graphics on USGS websites are copyrighted and need the holder's permission.
entries.description: US volcanoes monitored by the USGS volcano observatories; the HANS site groups notices under AVO, CalVO, CVO, HVO, NMI and YVO. The feed carries current notices (daily, weekly and monthly updates, volcano activity notifications and Volcano Observatory Notices for Aviation). History start, update frequency and delay: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no key. The CAP RSS feed is served directly at volcanoes.usgs.gov/hans2/rss/cap/.

entries.attribution: Requested, not required: "When using information from USGS information products, publications, or websites, we ask that proper credit be given." Suggested short form: "Credit: U.S. Geological Survey".

entries.name: Wikimedia Pageviews
entries.licence_note: Wikimedia's Analytics API access policy: "Data provided by the API is available under the CC0 1.0 license". entries.description: Page views for Wikimedia projects (Wikipedia has over 300 language editions, plus Wiktionary, Commons and others). Per-article views: daily or monthly only, from Jul 1, 2015 (earlier days return no data), by access method (desktop, mobile-web, mobile-app) and agent type (user, spider, automated). Project-wide totals are also served hourly, and hourly page-view files for all pages are on dumps.wikimedia.org from May 2015. About a day behind: on Oct 26, 2026 the latest per-article day was Oct 25.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free, no API key. A descriptive User-Agent header with contact details is required; clients without one "may be blocked without notice".
entries.rate_limits: Not stated for the Analytics API. The 200 requests/min (compliant User-Agent) and 10 requests/min (unidentified) figures on Wikimedia's general API rate-limit page are NOT stated for the Analytics API: that page names the Action API and REST APIs, does not mention the Analytics API, and calls its limits new in 2026 and subject to change. That page also asks clients to keep concurrent requests to 3 or fewer, which is likewise not stated for the Analytics API. The Analytics API access policy itself asks clients to wait for each request to finish before sending another.

entries.licence_note: The dataset metadata labels the license Creative Commons Attribution, and WRI states that CC BY 4.0 is its standard license for publications and data. Attribution and an indication of modifications are required.
entries.description: The checked version 1.3.0 CSV contains 34,936 plants in 167 countries and was released in June 2021. Its annual generation fields cover 2013 through 2017, and WRI does not state a recurring refresh schedule for the current file.
entries.free_tier_limits: Version 1.3.0 is a complete keyless ZIP download. No download quota is stated.
entries.attribution: Global Energy Observatory, Google, KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, Enipedia, World Resources Institute. 2021. Global Power Plant Database version 1.3.0. Accessed through https://datasets.wri.org/datasets/global-power-plant-database on <date>

entries.name: WTO Latest News RSS
entries.licence_note: Non-commercial use only. The WTO's Copyright and permissions page says: "Other material such as official publications can be reproduced for non-commercial purposes provided attribution is given to the WTO and the WTO is informed." It adds: "Commercial use of materials from the website requires written permission from the WTO." This news feed is treated as that other-material class unless a specific item is an official document or legal text. Signal Lab links to the official feed only.
entries.description: Latest-news feed (checked copy held 10 items); rolling current list, not a historical archive.
entries.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial use only. Free public RSS; no account or key. Feed is a rolling current list; retention and item count are not stated.
entries.tasks: news; rss; event-data; non-commercial; trade; multilateral
entries.attribution: Required: attribution to the WTO, and the WTO should be informed of non-commercial reproduction.

entries.name: Yahoo Finance
entries.licence_note: No data license. Yahoo's ToS bar automated collection without express prior permission; Yahoo Finance says its data must not be redistributed.
entries.description: Quotes, charts and historical data for stocks and indices on many US and international exchanges, plus US futures (CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX, ICE), currency rates and cryptocurrencies. Delays range from real-time to 30 minutes depending on exchange (Yahoo's help page lists each). No official API; Yahoo says data is for informational purposes only and must not be redistributed.

entries.name: Zenodo REST API
entries.licence_note: Metadata only: Zenodo says "Metadata is licensed under CC0, except for email addresses." Files are not covered: "Use and re-use is subject to the license under which the data objects were deposited." Zenodo's terms also state: "Access to Zenodo’s content is open to all, for non-military purposes only."
entries.auth: none for public records search (guest limits); free account and access token for higher limits, authenticated and deposit operations
entries.description: Records deposited on Zenodo by its users, with metadata and files; users must specify a licence for all publicly available files. Publication delay: Not stated.
entries.free_tier_limits: Guest users: 60 requests per minute and 2,000 per hour; authenticated users: 100 per minute and 5,000 per hour. Search REST endpoints and OAI-PMH harvesting: 30 requests per minute.

entries.name: Zebrafish Information Network (ZFIN) data downloads
entries.licence_note: CC-BY-4.0 for ZFIN data and data annotations, as stated on the Warranty and Liability Disclaimer, Ownership, and Limits on Use wiki, which links the versioned Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International deed. The same page says ZFIN software has a BSD 3-clause license. Agent note: this entry is the data and data annotations (the public download tables), not the ZFIN software and not personal or lab web pages hosted on ZFIN servers. Signal Lab links only.
entries.description: Zebrafish genes, lines, anatomy and annotations from ZFIN under CC BY 4.0. ZFIN is a maintained University of Oregon zebrafish genome informatics resource. This entry is the public download files, not the ZFIN software and not a personal lab web page on ZFIN servers.
entries.free_tier_limits: Free keyless downloads.
entries.attribution: Required under CC BY 4.0: credit the provider as the source and link the licence.
